chunks: When you go to the grave that is in Al-Baqi', make it in front of you.

Then you should say: Peace be upon you, O Imams of Guidance; Peace be upon you, People of Piety; Peace be upon you, Proofs upon the people of the world; Peace be upon you, Those who uphold justice among the creation; Peace be upon you, People of the Elite; Peace be upon you, People of the Inner Circle.

I testify that you have delivered (the Message) and preached, and were patient in the cause of Allah, and you were belied and treated poorly, yet you forgave. And I testify that you are the Righteous, Guided Imams, and that obedience to you is obligatory, and your word is the truth, and that you called but were not answered, and ordered but were not obeyed.

And that you are the pillars of the Religion and the cornerstones of the earth, and you have not ceased to be in the Eye of Allah, who reproduces you in the loins of every purified one and transfers you into the wombs of the purified ones. The ignorance of the ignorant did not soil you, nor did the trials of whimsical desires share in you. You are good, and goodly was your origin.

The Judge of the Religion has favored us with you, so He made you to be in the houses which Allah permitted to be elevated and His Name to be mentioned therein. He made our sending of blessings upon you a mercy for us and an expiation for our sins. When He chose you for us, He purified our creation by what He favored us with from your Wilayah, and we were named at His presence by your merit, acknowledging with our ratification.

Be aware! And this is the station of one who transgressed and erred and took shelter, and acknowledged what he committed, and hoped for deliverance by his station, and that the Deliverer would rescue him from destruction through you.
So be intercessors for me, for I have come as a delegate to you when the people of the world turned away from you, and took the Signs of Allah as mockery, and were arrogant about them.

O He who is Everlasting without forgetting, and Permanent without vanity, and Encompassing all things. To You is the Favor with what You made me concordant with and introduced me to, from what You entrusted me with. When Your servants turned away from them, were ignorant of their recognition, took their rights lightly, and inclined to others besides them.

Thus is the Favor from You upon me along with a people You specialized with what You specialized me with. So for You is the Praise, when I am mentioned and recorded at Your presence in this station of mine.
And do not deprive me of what I hoped for, nor disappoint me in what I supplicated for. And supplicate for yourself with whatever you like.

key_terms.الْبَقِيعِ: Al-Baqi', a famous cemetery in Medina

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication recited when visiting the graves in Al-Baqi?
ai.summary: This supplication, found in *Al-Kafi*, serves as a comprehensive theological declaration of the Imams' status as *Hujjah* (proofs) and pillars of the faith, emphasizing their purity from *Jahiliyyah* and their role as intercessors. It contextualizes the visitation not merely as mourning but as an affirmation of *Wilayah* and a plea for salvation through their mediation, reflecting the Shia doctrine of the Imams' enduring spiritual presence. The text highlights the contrast between the Imams' steadfastness and the world's neglect of their rights, reinforcing the concept of *Shafa'ah* (intercession) on the Day of Judgment.
